payload.name: trillion-crm-extract-dm-leads-v1
payload.description: Engine-fired DM lead extraction. Refresh every conversation source's producer (blind, DATA descriptors), decode each to canonical atoms via that source's own decoder capability, deterministically extract lead candidates, then write customer/v1 and lead-event/v1 rows into the visual-database CRM tables. Names no platform: sources are conversation_source_descriptor DATA rows (L069/L090). Empty inbox writes nothing (L145). Idempotent: customer and lead-event addresses are identity-derived so a re-pull is a byte-identical overwrite.
